values.task_boundary: Prepare and coordinate only Sprint 9 umbrella #537 and its exact five-child roster #515, #516, #517, #518, and #519.
deliverables: Sprint Execution Packet with exact membership, sequential gates, review path, and activity log
Integrated sprint review and truthful umbrella closeout record
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The Sprint Execution Packet records exact membership #515, #516, #517, #518, and #519 in dependency order.
AC-2: #515 waits for terminal #514; #516 waits for every named milestone root including #515; #517 waits for #516; #518 waits for #517; #519 waits for #518.
AC-3: Every child has a complete typed six-card bundle and issue-specific design-time plan before implementation handoff.
AC-4: Every child handoff requires a bound FastWork worktree, current readiness, and issue-bound session goal before implementation.
AC-5: Admission, quality, documentation, and publication-candidate checks fail closed on missing, stale, skipped, non-proving, or non-ancestral evidence.
AC-6: The umbrella closes only after all five children have reviewed terminal outcomes and one integrated sprint review has no unresolved actionable findings.
dependencies: All #516 named milestone roots including #515 before #516
non_goals: Provider benchmark marketing claims or production cutover
Merging, tagging, releasing, or publishing the milestone
Claiming completion for blocked or nonterminal roots
